title: Helvidius Priscus
lead: A Stoic senator under Nero and Vespasian, son-in-law of Thrasea Paetus, known in Tacitus for his quarrel with Eprius Marcellus and his plain speech to emperors. Tacitus gives his early life at Histories 4:5. He is not named in the Bible; his world is the Rome of Paul's trial and of the emperor Vespasian.
